browser.title: Browser sign-in
browser.description:
The Post login asks for an additional step, for example multi-factor authentication or new terms of use. Please sign in with your browser:

1. Open the developer tools of your browser (F12), switch to the **Network** tab and enable **Preserve log**.
2. Open the [Post sign-in page]({url}) and complete the sign-in.
3. At the end the browser fails to open an address starting with `msal228c4360-`. Copy this complete address from the **Location** header of the last request to the Post login (or from the address bar or error page) and paste it below.

The link is valid for a single attempt.

data_description.redirect_url: The complete address starting with `msal228c4360-`, including the `code` parameter.
